question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

 XY, VV, TR, ?, PG, NZ, LR, JI
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bf33a49ede2839ae63f0c1803ac987ca0a96bc5d46fc85e177ba0a3717afde7.png] 

The logic followed here is: The positional value of 1st letter of every word is decreased by (-2) and 2nd letter is decreased by in series (3,4,5,6,7,8,9).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df7587afb8d8b52c0f4814c3e4029ec20f1e401eb9c26645d7f63830dd03800.png] 

∴ According to the logic followed here RM will replace the (?) mark.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
